about: State of a spell-impact sound emitter entity on the client: a path mover that moves the sound from the impact position towards the local listener, plus the impact position/rotation, the computed sound position, the spell, two FixedStrings (sound names) and the owning entity and listener index. Created and updated by ecl::spell::ImpactSoundSystem (Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xD6A6C0: ProcessNewSpellImpacts / ProcessCurrentSpellImpacts / FinalizeState). Never seen alive. Registry total 424 (client row).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x1DDD7D0 (AllocRaw 0x1A8) does memset(p,0,0x128) then eoc::PathMover::PathMover(p); destructor bg3.exe+0x6C2510 ends with FUN_1405946c0(p+0x110) (the PathMover's ComputedVelocityValues array) and FUN_1405f3fd0(p). Toolkit FinalizeState assigns eoc::path::Settings::operator=(p) and writes +0x50/+0x58 (SourcePosition), +0x5C..+0x68 (SourceRotation), +0x6C..+0x74 (TargetPosition), +0x78..+0x84 (TargetRotation) - exactly Script Extender's path::PathMover (Base/ExposedTypes.h, 0x128 bytes). Kept as bytes because PathMover holds std::variant members; it equals SE path::PathMover.

Creator zeroes 0x128..0x133. Toolkit FinalizeState: `*(u64*)(p+0x128) = req.pos.xy; *(float*)(p+0x130) = req.pos.z` (the same vector it writes as the path's SourcePosition +0x50). Game ProcessCurrentSpellImpacts bg3.exe+0x1DDC0C0 / Toolkit read +0x128 (8) and +0x130 (4) to build a transform.

Creator: qwords 0x130/0x138 zero and `*(u64*)(p+0x140) = 0x3F800000` -> +0x140 = 1.0f, i.e. identity quaternion x,y,z,w at 0x134..0x143. Toolkit ProcessCurrentSpellImpacts reads +0x134 and +0x13C as two qwords into the transform beside the position.

Toolkit FinalizeState writes +0x144/+0x14C = impact position + direction * (distance + offset) and copies it into the path's TargetPosition (+0x6C); ProcessCurrentSpellImpacts rewrites +0x144/+0x14C when the listener moves. Creator zeroes it.

Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xD67B00 FinalizeState stores the rule's float +0x24 here and adds it to the listener distance; +0x24 is SoundSpellTrajectoryRule::DistancePastListener in Script Extender's resource layout (eoc::sound::SpellTrajectoryRules: RuleName +0x18, CurveUuid +0x1C, SoundEvent +0x20). ProcessCurrentSpellImpacts adds it again when it moves the sound. Was DistanceOffset, a name of ours.
padding before the 8-aligned SpellId (creator writes the dword at 0x150 only).

Creator writes 0xFFFFFFFF at +0x158 (OriginatorPrototype), 0x17 at +0x160 (SourceType Sentinel), zeroes 0x168..0x187 (Source, ProgressionSource) and 0xFFFFFFFF at +0x188 (Prototype). Destructor calls eoc::spell::SpellId::~SpellId(p+0x158); Toolkit FinalizeState does SpellId::operator=(p+0x158, request spell). Equals SE eoc::spell::SpellId (0x38).

Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xD67B00 ecl::spell::ImpactSoundSystem::FinalizeState looks the impact's rule up with eoc::sound::SpellTrajectoryRules::GetByRuleName and assigns rule +0x1C here (FixedString::operator=, state +400); Script Extender's resource SoundSpellTrajectoryRule (engine class eoc::sound::SpellTrajectoryRules: VMT, ResourceUUID, then RuleName +0x18, CurveUuid +0x1C, SoundEvent +0x20, DistancePastListener +0x24) declares +0x1C as CurveUuid. The same value goes into the path settings' velocity mapping.

Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xD67B00 FinalizeState assigns the rule's +0x20 here, SoundSpellTrajectoryRule::SoundEvent in Script Extender's resource layout (see CurveUuid); a later loop of the same function copies +0x194 into the Event of an ecl::sound::SpellImpactRequestBusComponent sound request.
Creator writes 0xFFC0000000000000 (null handle) at +0x198. Toolkit FinalizeState stores the iterated source entity (`*(u64*)(p+0x198) = *pIVar22`).

Creator writes 0xFF (-1) at +0x1A0. Toolkit ProcessCurrentSpellImpacts reads `(char)p[0x1A0]` and uses it as index (asserting 0..3) into ls::StaticArray<ls::Optional<Vector3f>,4> of listener positions (one per local player input); FinalizeState writes it from local_2b8.

survey.live_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
open_questions: Path is kept as 296 bytes (SE path::PathMover has std::variant members); its internals are not redeclared.
Meaning of the two FixedStrings at 0x190/0x194 (mapping vs. sound event) is a guess from FinalizeState; named field_*.
ImpactRotation is never written by FinalizeState (stays identity?) - only read.
ListenerIndex is a signed char in the code (0xFF = none); written as uint8_t because int8_t is not in the build's type list.
Not seen alive (seen.py has no samples).
